g.text: Cross-Pod attachment resolution and content streaming
BEGIN; lock all IDs in stable order
[any item fails authorization or state validation]
size and SHA-256 in request order
Resolve is all-or-nothing. No partial run starts.
There is no content_version because each ID
maps to one immutable object and digest.
The content stream propagates cancellation and
backpressure. It never creates a local file or
materializes the complete object in Pod memory.
PDF and scripts are untrusted user content.
They cannot become system or tool instructions.
JavaScript is stored and read, never executed.
